{{Quote|For an illuminating example of pan-species cooperation, don't miss the moon of Alchenaut, where palm-sized furballs that I named o'cerrys act as a predator warning system for thousands of other herbivores.|An excerpt from ''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'', by Jedi biologist Bowspritz|<ref name="TJP" />}}
The '''o'cerry''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Diet/Legends|herbivore]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Alchenaut]]. Discovered and named by [[Jedi Biologist|Jedi biologist]] [[Bowspritz]] at some point prior to [[990 BBY]], the species was noted for its habit of acting as a predator alarm for other herbivores in the ecosystem. Bowspritz included o'cerry in the "[[The galaxy/Legends|Galactic]] Bestiary" section of ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'', which introduced the species to numerous generations of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainees]].

==Biology and appearance==
A [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Diet/Legends|herbivore]] [[Species/Legends|species]], o'cerrys were [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Alchenaut]],<ref name="TJP" /> which was located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Atlas Appendix">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Described as "palm-sized" by [[Jedi Biologist|Jedi biologist]] [[Bowspritz]], they were round in shape and mostly covered with thick [[Hair/Legends|fur]] of greenish gray [[Color/Legends|color]], except for their faces, which exposed the species' brownish skin. O'cerrys had two gray-blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], which were large in proportion to their faces. Between the eyes, they had a flat [[Nose/Legends|nose]] with two nostrils and under them a wide [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]].<ref name="TJP" />

==Behavior==
The o'cerrys collaborated with thousands of other herbivores living in the same ecosystem by warning them of approaching predators.<ref name="TJP" />

==History==
Sometime prior to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[990 BBY]],<ref name="TJP-PublishingDate">According to [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path'']], the book was first published "a decade or more after the end of the [[New Sith Wars]] in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]." This is taken here to mean the year 990 BBY.</ref> the species was discovered and named by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Researcher|biologist]] Bowspritz. O'cerrys' existence and other pertinent details about the species were subsequently recorded in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]]. Considering the o'cerry an enlightening occurrence of cooperation between species, Bowspritz included it in the "Galactic Bestiary" section of the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainee]] instruction [[Book/Legends|guidebook]] ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'', which exhibited animals the trainees might come across when roaming the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="TJP" /> First printed as early as 990 BBY,<ref name="TJP-PublishingDate" /> the book introduced o'cerrys to generations of Jedi students, as it was still used [[Time/Legends|centuries]] later during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|began]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="TJP" />

==Behind the scenes==
O'cerrys were mentioned in [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']], a [[2010]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]]. The o'cerry illustration in the book was drawn by [[Derek Thompson]].<ref name="TJP" />
